q1_issues.issue: The of-phrase of the quality nominalization "the urgency of this" is encoded as a reified state with (Experiencer sk_urgency_1 sk_request_1), although no reification trigger is present and the noun-complement section's entity-attached surface-preposition oblique on the noun's own symbol is the closest licensed form.

The definite "the urgency" keeps its typing atom (Member sk_urgency_1 urgency) inside the strength-0 denial bundle, where the projection table puts a definite participant's typing at top level - as the parse itself does for "this request".

q2_gaps: of-phrase naming the BEARER of a quality nominalization ("the urgency of this"): the noun-complement rule covers only a nominalization's OBJECT of-phrase and true relational nouns (kinship / role / part-like)
first-person pronoun "I" as speaker deixis: the antecedentless-pronoun rule enumerates he / she / they / it and mints an anonymous witness, and says nothing about the speaker of the utterance
notes: Routing is otherwise right: "see" with an entity object keeps Experiencer/Stimulus, each clause is its own strength-0 bundle, and coordinating "and" correctly yields no connective atom. Resolving "this" forward to sk_request_1 is defensible under the cataphora / salience rule.
